result.summary: 本文介绍了 Qwen2.5-VL 系列视觉语言模型，旨在提升细粒度视觉感知并构建面向真实应用的智能体能力 [S1.p1]。模型采用原生动态分辨率 ViT、窗口注意力、动态 FPS 采样以及对齐绝对时间的 MRoPE，并扩大了预训练语料规模 [S1.p4]。在多项基准上，旗舰模型 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在文档与图表理解等方面可与 GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Sonnet 等模型匹敌，较小的 7B 与 3B 版本也优于同规模竞品 [S4.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文指出，当前视觉语言模型面临计算复杂度、上下文理解有限、细粒度视觉感知不足以及不同序列长度下性能不一致等发展瓶颈 [S1.p3]。为此，Qwen2.5-VL 致力于探索细粒度感知能力，为 LVLMs 建立坚实基础，并打造面向真实应用的智能体放大器 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: vision-language models currently face developmental bottlenecks, including computational complexity, limited contextual understanding, poor fine-grained visual perception, and inconsistent performance across varied sequence length.
we are committed to exploring fine-grained perception capabilities, aiming to establish a robust foundation for LVLMs and create an agentic amplifier for real-world applications.

method.text: Qwen2.5-VL 在视觉编码器中引入窗口注意力以优化推理效率，并引入动态 FPS 采样将动态分辨率扩展到时间维度 [S1.p4]。模型将 MRoPE 的时间分量与绝对时间对齐，使模型能在不同 FPS 采样率的视频间学习一致的时间对齐 [S2.SS1.SSS3.p3]。此外，模型采用基于 MLP 的视觉-语言合并器，将空间相邻的四组 patch 特征拼接后经两层 MLP 投影到与文本嵌入对齐的维度 [S2.SS1.p4]。

evidence.quote: We implement window attention in the visual encoder to optimize inference efficiency
We introduce dynamic FPS sampling, extending dynamic resolution to the temporal dimension
aligning the temporal component of MRoPE with absolute time
the model is able to learn consistent temporal alignment across videos with different FPS sampling rates.
we first group spatially adjacent sets of four patch features.
passed through a two-layer multi-layer perceptron (MLP) to project them into a dimension that aligns with the text embeddings

experiments.text: 实验将 Qwen2.5-VL 与 Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620、GPT-4o-0513、InternVL2.5 以及不同规模的 Qwen2-VL 等模型进行对比 [S3.SS1.p1]。评估覆盖大学水平问题、数学、通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个基准 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p3][S3.SS3.SSS3.p3][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p1]。视频评估使用了时长从几秒到数小时不等的基准，包括 Video-MME、LVBench、MLVU 等 [S3.SS3.SSS4.p1]。

evidence.quote: comparing it with state-of-the-art models such as Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620, GPT-4o-0513, InternVL2.5, and different sizes of Qwen2-VL.
on composite OCR-related understanding benchmarks as OCRBench, InfoVQA
Qwen2.5-VL achieves leading performance across different benchmarks from box-grounding, and point-grounding to counting.
utilizing benchmarks that include videos ranging from a few seconds to several hours in length.
Video-MME, Video-MMMU, MMVU, MVBench, MMBench-Video, LongVideoBench, EgoSchema, PerceptionTest, MLVU, LVBench, TempCompass and Charades-STA.
The UI elements grounding is evaluated by ScreenSpot and ScreenSpot Pro.

findings.text: 在大学水平问题上，Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在 MMMU 上取得 70.2 分，在 MMMU-Pro 上取得 51.1 分，超过此前开源最优模型并与 GPT-4o 相当 [S3.SS1.p1]。在数学任务上，其在 MathVista 上取得 74.8 分，超过此前开源最优的 72.3 分 [S3.SS1.p2]。在通用视觉问答上，其在 MMBench-EN 上取得 88.6 分，略高于此前最佳的 88.3 分 [S3.SS1.p3]。在智能体基准上，Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在 ScreenSpot 上达到 87.1% 准确率，在 ScreenSpot Pro 上达到 43.6%，远超 Aguvis-72B 的 23.6% 和 Qwen2-VL-72B 的 1.6% [S3.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

evidence.quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves a score of 70.2 on MMMU.
For MMMU-Pro, Qwen2.5-VL-72B scores 51.1, surpassing the previous open-source state-of-the-art models
On MathVista, it achieves a score of 74.8, outperforming the previous open-source state-of-the-art score of 72.3.
On MMbench-EN, it achieves a score of 88.6, slightly surpassing the previous best score of 88.3.
It achieves 87.1% accuracy on ScreenSpot
setting a new standard on ScreenSpot Pro with 43.6% accuracy - far surpassing both Aguvis-72B (23.6%) and its foundation Qwen2-VL-72B (1.6%).

limitations.text: 作者指出，将 CoT 推理应用于视觉语言模型的一个关键挑战是模型同时依赖文本和视觉模态，中间推理步骤可能未能充分整合视觉信息，要么忽略相关视觉线索，要么误解它们 [S2.SS3.SSS3.p4]。作者承认，尽管采取了过滤策略，实现最优的模态对齐仍是一个需要进一步推进的持续挑战 [S2.SS3.SSS3.p4]。

evidence.quote: Intermediate reasoning steps may fail to adequately integrate visual information, either by ignoring relevant visual cues or misinterpreting them.
achieving optimal modality alignment remains an ongoing challenge that requires further advancements.
